actions: su -c 'echo BOOT; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; echo GPU_MIN; cat /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/min_pwrlevel; echo GPU_CLOCK; cat /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/gpuclk; echo PERFETTO_PROGRAM; command -v perfetto; echo PERFETTO_QUERY_BEGIN; timeout 5 perfetto --query; rc=$?; echo PERFETTO_QUERY_END_EXIT=$rc; echo UPTIME; cat /proc/uptime; exit $rc'
su -c 'echo BOOT; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; echo FOREGROUND; timeout 4 dumpsys activity activities | grep -E "mResumedActivity|topResumedActivity" || true; echo UPTIME; cat /proc/uptime'
